title: Function-Space Transformer with Adaptive Anchors
abstract: arXiv:2609.38348v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many forms of data, including physical fields, geometric shapes, and visual signals, are naturally described by functions over continuous domains but are observed through discrete samples. Representing these functions on fixed uniform grids imposes a trade-off between resolving localized variation and increasing computation across the domain. Neural operators address this mismatch by learning mappings between functions, while latent-attention architectures provide flexible processing of sampled observations. We introduce the Function-Space Transformer (FST), a framework for learning from functions through a spatially adaptive continuous latent representation. FST stores features at anchors whose locations are predicted from the input observations and recursively refines these anchor features through function-space interactions. translated_title: 具有自适应锚点的函数空间Transformer
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.38348v1 公告类型：new 摘要：许多形式的数据，包括物理场、几何形状和视觉信号，天然地由连续域上的函数来描述，但只能通过离散样本进行观测。在固定的均匀网格上表示这些函数，会在刻画局部变化与增加全域计算量之间造成权衡。神经算子通过学习函数之间的映射来解决这种不匹配，而潜在注意力架构则提供了对采样观测的灵活处理。我们提出了函数空间Transformer（FST），这是一种通过空间自适应的连续潜在表示从函数中学习的框架。FST 将特征存储在锚点上，锚点的位置由输入观测预测得到，并通过函数空间交互递归地精炼这些锚点特征。这使得表示能够根据每个输入自适应地调整其空间组织方式，而不是继承（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出函数空间Transformer（FST），通过从输入观测预测锚点位置并递归精炼锚点特征的空间自适应连续潜在表示，使模型能够针对每个输入动态调整空间组织方式，从而突破固定均匀网格在表示连续域函数时的权衡限制。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the Function-Space Transformer (FST), which learns from functions via a spatially adaptive continuous latent representation—predicting anchor locations from input observations and recursively refining anchor features through function-space interactions—allowing the spatial organization of the representation to adapt to each input rather than inheriting a fixed uniform grid.
